cohort: 100 postnatal women with iron-deficiency anemia (hemoglobin < 11 g/dL) admitted to the postnatal ward of the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department in SP Medical College, Bikaner, India.
finding: Ferric carboxymaltose (FCM) resulted in faster and greater improvements in hemoglobin, serum ferritin, and blood indices compared to iron sucrose in postnatal women with iron-deficiency anemia.
